title: A withdrawn instruction no longer applies
checks: Once the person takes an instruction back, later replies stop following it.
why: Instructions that stick after being withdrawn make the assistant feel stubborn and hard to steer.

case.name: A withdrawn instruction no longer applies
case.about: After the person withdraws it, replies stop following the instruction to {{preference}}.

turns.message: You can drop that instruction about how to answer. Go back to your normal style.

reply.reference: Handles the request in its normal style; the withdrawn instruction is gone.
rubric: It is not true that the reply {{effect}}
